name: Robo-Dopamine-Bench
description:
Benchmark for "Robo-Dopamine: General Process Reward Modeling for High-Precision Robotic Manipulation"

Joy is dopamine’s handiwork—whether in humans or in robotics.



  
   
  
   
  


Please follow the steps below to use this benchmark

	
	
	
		🛠️ Setup
	

# clone repo.
git clonehttps://github.com/FlagOpen/Robo-Dopamine.git
cd Robo-Dopamine

# build conda env.
conda create -n robo-dopamine python=3.10
conda activate robo-dopamine
pip install -r requirements.txt


	
		
		🔍 Evaluation… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/tanhuajie2001/Robo-Dopamine-Bench.
reputation: An emerging robotics benchmark with growing interest among research groups working on reward modeling and high-precision manipulation.
